description: This file provides a set of helper functions to interact with the backend API for content operations such as fetching feeds, posts, user profiles, media uploads, and post creation. It wraps REST endpoints, handles request parameters, and normalizes errors.

methods.name: fetchMyFeed({ cursor = null, limit = 12 } = {})
methods.description: Fetches the authenticated user's feed with optional cursor-based pagination, returning items and the next cursor.

methods.name: fetchExplore({ cursor = null, limit = 18 } = {})
methods.description: Fetches explore/public posts with optional cursor pagination, returning items and the next cursor.

methods.name: fetchPostById(id)
methods.description: Fetches a specific post by its ID.

methods.name: likePost(id)
methods.description: Likes a post given its ID.

methods.name: unlikePost(id)
methods.description: Unlikes a post given its ID.

methods.name: fetchUserProfile(username)
methods.description: Fetches a public user profile by username.

methods.name: updateMyProfile(payload)
methods.description: Updates the current user's profile with provided payload.

methods.name: fetchPostsByUsername(username, { cursor = null, limit = 12 } = {})
methods.description: Fetches posts created by a specific user, with pagination options.

methods.name: getMediaSignature(payload = {})
methods.description: Requests a signed payload for media upload to Cloudinary.

methods.name: uploadMediaServer({ file, folder, resource_type = "auto", public_id, tags } = {})
methods.description: Uploads media via a server endpoint that proxies to Cloudinary, supporting multipart form data.

methods.name: createPost(payload)
methods.description: Creates a new post with provided payload, including media, caption, hashtags, and visibility.

ctags.pattern: /^export async function fetchExplore({ cursor = null, limit = 18 } = {}) {$/
